classification.difficultyReason: Complete right triangles by selecting side and inverse trigonometric ratios, using Pythagoras where appropriate and applying two rounding precisions.

content.prompt: Find all sides, correct to two decimal places, and all angles, correct to one decimal place.

spec.description: Vertical left leg, horizontal upper leg and rising diagonal; right angle at upper left and 40° at lower left. Unfilled black house-style reconstruction.
spec.mathematics: The vertical leg is 3 cm and is adjacent to the given 40° angle.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied 3 cm, 40° and right-angle marker are visible.

answer.short: Sides: $3\text{ cm}$, $2.52\text{ cm}$ and $3.92\text{ cm}$. Angles: $40.0^\circ$, $50.0^\circ$ and $90.0^\circ$.
answer.worked:
Let $h$ be the hypotenuse, $x$ the horizontal side and $\alpha$ the remaining acute angle.
$$\begin{align*}
\cos40^\circ&=\frac{3}{h}\\
h\cos40^\circ&=3\\
h&=\frac{3}{\cos40^\circ}\\
h&\approx3.92\text{ cm}\\
\tan40^\circ&=\frac{x}{3}\\
x&=3\tan40^\circ\\
x&\approx2.52\text{ cm}\\
\alpha&=90^\circ-40^\circ\\
\alpha&=50.0^\circ
\end{align*}$$
The supplied side is $3\text{ cm}$; the other angles are $40.0^\circ$ and $90.0^\circ$.

spec.description: Right triangle with vertical left leg, horizontal base and diagonal descending from upper left to lower right; right angle at lower left. Unfilled black house-style reconstruction.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied lengths and the right-angle marker are visible.

answer.short: Sides: $6\text{ cm}$, $6.97\text{ cm}$ and $9.2\text{ cm}$. Angles: $40.7^\circ$, $49.3^\circ$ and $90.0^\circ$.
answer.worked:
Let $x$ be the horizontal side, $\theta$ the lower-right angle and $\phi$ the upper-left angle.
$$\begin{align*}
x^2+6^2&=9.2^2\\
x^2&=9.2^2-6^2\\
x&=\sqrt{9.2^2-6^2}\\
x&\approx6.97\text{ cm}\\
\sin\theta&=\frac{6}{9.2}\\
\theta&=\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{6}{9.2}\right)\\
\theta&\approx40.7^\circ\\
\phi&=90^\circ-\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{6}{9.2}\right)\\
\phi&\approx49.3^\circ
\end{align*}$$
The supplied sides are $6\text{ cm}$ and $9.2\text{ cm}$; the right angle is $90.0^\circ$.

spec.description: Triangle with horizontal lower hypotenuse and upper right-angle vertex; left sloping leg 5 cm and right sloping leg 8.4 cm. Unfilled black house-style reconstruction.
spec.mathematics: Perpendicular legs 5 cm and 8.4 cm; horizontal base is the hypotenuse.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied lengths and the upper right-angle marker are visible.

answer.short: Sides: $5\text{ cm}$, $8.4\text{ cm}$ and $9.78\text{ cm}$. Angles: $59.2^\circ$ at the lower left, $30.8^\circ$ at the lower right and $90.0^\circ$ at the top.
answer.worked:
Let $h$ be the hypotenuse, $\theta$ the lower-left angle and $\phi$ the lower-right angle.
$$\begin{align*}
h^2&=5^2+8.4^2\\
h&=\sqrt{5^2+8.4^2}\\
h&\approx9.78\text{ cm}\\
\tan\theta&=\frac{8.4}{5}\\
\theta&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{8.4}{5}\right)\\
\theta&\approx59.2^\circ\\
\phi&=90^\circ-\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{8.4}{5}\right)\\
\phi&\approx30.8^\circ
\end{align*}$$
The supplied sides are $5\text{ cm}$ and $8.4\text{ cm}$; the upper angle is $90.0^\circ$.
